case.summary: The alert was triggered when customer C13171 reported that they never made the $55.68 online purchase identified as transaction 3558054. The strongest findings are that the customer disputed this transaction and that three online purchases of product C, each around $55.68, occurred within a 20-minute window on the same Chrome 66.0 device, while the device profile had been used by this card nine times previously. The case was judged to be fraud with a probability of 0.93. The recommended actions are to block the card and open a new investigation case.
